attention.storageDetail: VictoriaMetrics, which keeps the series inside this container, does not answer. Nothing is scraped or kept until it does; Metrics starts it again on its own. Its logs are in the container's.
attention.disk: Only {{free}} free on the data volume
attention.diskDetail: When the volume is nearly full, VictoriaMetrics stops taking new samples. Give the volume more space or keep series for fewer days (METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS).

metricList.name: Name

targetsPage.description: Everything scraped, whether it answers and its last error.

jobs.description: Exporters and services you add. The OpenAsy products and Metrics itself are scraped as the job openasy without one.
jobs.addDetail: Each address is scraped as one target. node_exporter answers on 9100, most other exporters on a port of their own.
jobs.deleteDetail: It is not scraped from now on; what it brought is kept for the retention.
jobs.name: Name
jobs.nameHint: The job label, such as node
jobs.urlsHint: One per line. An address without a path reads /metrics.
jobs.labelsHint: name=value, one per line, added to every series it brings
jobs.sealed: Sealed with this install's key and never shown again.
jobs.noneDetail: Add node_exporter on your hosts, or a database's exporter.

setupPage.description: What Metrics scrapes on its own, and how other tools read from it and send to it.
setupPage.productsDetail_one: {{count}} product of OPENASY_PRODUCTS is scraped at its /metrics, besides Metrics itself.
setupPage.productsDetail_other: {{count}} products of OPENASY_PRODUCTS are scraped at their /metrics, besides Metrics itself.
setupPage.grafanaDetail: Metrics answers PromQL as Prometheus does. Add it as a Prometheus data source with an API token of the viewer role.
setupPage.vmalertDetail: vmalert or Prometheus evaluates alert rules over these series and sends what fires to Alerts.
setupPage.otelDetail: A collector pushes metrics over OTLP/HTTP with protobuf, with METRICS_INGEST_TOKEN or an API token of the editor role.
setupPage.remoteWriteDetail: A Prometheus or agent that keeps its own scraping sends its samples here.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your profile, password, two-step verification and where you are signed in.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who can sign in to this Metrics, and with which role. Viewers see and query everything; editors also keep dashboards; admins also add scrape jobs, and manage members and tokens.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.description: Identity providers people can sign in with, such as OpenAsy Identity, Keycloak or Microsoft Entra ID, and which of their groups give which role.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For Grafana, vmalert, scripts and CI. Each token has one role and an expiry; the secret is shown once.
